_what: Skills the AI Capabilities modal promises for the measured shapes that NO battery prompt has yet proven (the skills-side sibling of unprompted-baseline.json). An entry leaves when a prompt with expectSkill scores skillHit against it. Like the tool baseline, this may only SHRINK.
_gate: Measurement is only meaningful on a bundle carrying AI_CONTEXT_VERSION >= 27: the flat pre-v27 layout is never registered as a skill (measured live 2026-08-27 — every directory-format skill registered, zero flat files), so on an older bundle every entry scores SKILL-AS-PROSE at best. Deploying v27 to the rig's projects needs F5 + the activation sweep — a supervised edge. Until then this file is the promise, not yet a scoreboard.
_ratchet: No automatic ratchet test enforces this file yet (the tool baseline has toolPromptCoverage.test.ts; the skills one is added with the first skill batch). Saying so here rather than silently: a cap nobody enforces reads as covered when it is not.
_shapes: home = the projects root (cwd default); project = inside bodea (prompts declare cwd: 'project'). The demo-builder set is promised on both; the aem bundle only inside an EDS project. bodea builds no App Builder app, so the appbuilder bundle is correctly absent there (AI-1o).
